The institutional investor held 30,468 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.11M, down from 41,166 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $939.92 billion market cap company.
